name: Flutter platform channels
summary: Flutter's built-in message-passing APIs for invoking platform-specific Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux code from Dart.
advantages: Direct and flexible access to platform-specific APIs
Suitable for one-off or custom native integrations
tradeoffs: Method names and payload contracts can become stringly typed when handwritten
Large interfaces require manual synchronization between Dart and native code
recommendedFor: Projects that need direct control over message-channel APIs
Cases where generated bridge code is unnecessary

verification.reason: Flutter official platform-channel documentation is sufficient.
